question:
**Direction: Read the given passage and select the most appropriate set of words for the blanks.**

Humans blink their eyes ______ to flush away the stream of cleansing tears produced by the ducts present in the corners of our eyes. Adults ______ their eyes about 15 times per minute.
solution:
The correct answer is **"automatically; blink."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The first blank talks blinking of an eye which is an unconscious effort.
 
• **"Automatically"** means without conscious thought or effort. (यंत्रवत, अपने आप)
 
 
• **Example**: *The lights will come on **automatically**__ when it gets dark.*
 
 
 
• So, the correct word for the first blank is** "automatically."**
